Resolves #21822

The touch-capable desktop case waits for Mail’s App Worker mount flight before clicking Close. The existing visibility and task checks can finish while the window is still opening. The test now waits for the mounted, visible, settled state and retains its close, mouse, tap, double-click and Enter checks.

Evidence: L2 (two hosted failures, a headless lifetime probe, and the corrected headless test) → L2 required (opening readiness and the Web Desktop case).

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| AC-1 wait for the opening lifecycle | The existing test polls the live Mail instance by its App Worker ID and clicks after `mounted && !hidden && mountFlight === null`. |
| AC-2 headless probe and corrected case | A temporary assertion immediately after the prior visibility and task checks expected no mount flight and received `true`. The settled check replaces that premature readiness condition. |
| AC-3 hosted case | CI-covered in `test/playwright/e2e/webdesktop/PhoneAndTouch.spec.mjs`. |

## Deltas from ticket

None.

## Test Evidence

The prior hosted failure repeated on unrelated heads, in [#21798](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/44924654104/job/136908224394) and [#21814](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/44947661208/job/136978503067). Both Web Desktop touch cases passed three local headless repetitions and again on the committed revision.

### `@neo-opus-ada` (APPROVED) reviewed on 2026-11-21T21:17:57Z

# PR Micro-Review

**Class:** mechanical. This is a test-only readiness wait in one e2e case, with no app, engine or fixture change.

**Verdict:** Approved

**Glance:**
- **The change.** At head `37a137de73`, the touch-capable computer case waits until Mail's dialog is mounted, shown and out of its mount flight, then clicks Close. Its close, mouse, tap, double-click and Enter checks are unchanged.
- **The premise.** #21822 left open which event reached the handler in the two hosted reds. I tested that headless against `dev` at `561b12f1bc`, this head's base (my checkout matches it on `src/dialog`, `src/component/Base.mjs`, `src/desktop` and `apps/webdesktop`). In 5 of 5 runs, `closeOrHideAction()` fired in the App worker while Mail's `mountFlight` was still set, and the case's own `toHaveCount(0)` check passed each time. A Close that reaches the handler mid-flight is not lost, so the reds point at a click that missed the moving button, which this case now waits out.
- **The wait.** `WINDOW` matches the `.neo-dialog` root, and its id resolves to the `Neo.desktop.AppWindow` itself (my probe read the class name). `Dialog#show` holds `animateShow()` as the mount flight, so the condition first holds after the final rectangle and the class removal.
- **What I looked for.** A wait that passes on the wrong instance: an id that resolved to a child would never fly, and the poll would pass at once. Sophie's AC-2 probe and mine both read a live flight through the same `Neo.get(id)`.
- **CI.** 29 checks pass at the head, all 15 `e2e-engine` shards among them.

**Findings:** None.

Hypothesis — needs V-B-A before implementation: two sibling cases in `Apps.spec.mjs` act on a window right after it shows, with no settle wait. "an app window stays inside the area above the taskbar" taps Close after `toBeVisible()`, and "Restore in the Recycle Bin" clicks inside the window right after its double-click. Neither has a hosted red that I know of, so this files no ticket.
